mapper.select: SELECT oi.id, oi.order_id, oi.spu_id, oi.sku_id, oi.spu_code_snapshot, oi.product_name_snapshot, oi.sku_code_snapshot, oi.spec_name_snapshot, oi.spec_values_snapshot, oi.sale_unit_snapshot, oi.product_type_snapshot, oi.ordered_quantity, oi.actual_quantity, oi.actual_quantity_source, oi.actual_quantity_reason, oi.sort_order, oi.version, oi.created_at, oi.updated_at FROM sales_order_item oi JOIN sales_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.deleted = FALSE WHERE o.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND oi.deleted = FALSE AND oi.actual_quantity IS NOT NULL AND oi.actual_quantity > 0 AND o.confirmed_at >= #{startAt} AND o.confirmed_at < #{endAt} ORDER BY oi.sku_id ASC, o.confirmed_at ASC, oi.id ASC

SELECT d.id, d.sales_order_id, d.sales_order_no_snapshot, d.sales_order_item_id, d.sku_id, d.sku_code_snapshot AS sku_code, d.sku_name_snapshot AS sku_name, d.product_name_snapshot AS product_name, d.spec_values_snapshot AS spec_values, d.demand_unit_snapshot AS demand_unit, d.product_type_snapshot AS product_type, d.required_quantity, d.allocated_quantity, (d.required_quantity - d.allocated_quantity) AS unallocated_quantity, d.supplier_id, s.name AS supplier_name, d.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, d.status, d.demand_date, d.source_confirmed_at, d.version, d.created_at FROM purchase_demand d LEFT JOIN supplier s ON s.id = d.supplier_id AND s.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = d.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = FALSE WHERE d.deleted = FALSE AND d.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM purchase_demand WHERE deleted = FALSE AND id IN #{it} ORDER BY id ASC FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM purchase_demand WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM purchase_demand WHERE deleted = FALSE AND sales_order_item_id IN #{it} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_demand (sales_order_id, sales_order_item_id, spu_id, sku_id, sales_order_no_snapshot, spu_code_snapshot, product_name_snapshot, sku_code_snapshot, sku_name_snapshot, spec_values_snapshot, demand_unit_snapshot, product_type_snapshot, required_quantity, allocated_quantity, supplier_id, warehouse_id, purchaser_id, status, demand_date, source_confirmed_at, created_by) VALUES (#{row.salesOrderId}, #{row.salesOrderItemId}, #{row.spuId}, #{row.skuId}, #{row.salesOrderNoSnapshot}, #{row.spuCodeSnapshot}, #{row.productNameSnapshot}, #{row.skuCodeSnapshot}, #{row.skuNameSnapshot}, #{row.specValuesSnapshot,typeHandler=net.lab1024.sa.admin.module.scm.purchase.support.PurchaseJsonbTypeHandler}, #{row.demandUnitSnapshot}, #{row.productTypeSnapshot}, #{row.requiredQuantity}, 0, #{row.supplierId}, #{row.warehouseId}, #{row.purchaserId}, #{row.status}, #{row.demandDate}, #{row.sourceConfirmedAt}, #{row.createdBy}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
